title: Wingy's records: Downstream, Loch Lomond and other sides
summary: He recalls the Famous Door job and the six sides including Downstream, Loch Lomond and Where's the Waiter.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: How long before you started work with Wayne Eaton?

Oh, I don't know, it wasn't too long. I think it was just a few days after I met there or something like that. It was an old famous store. You see, the old famous store was on the, what we call the uptown side of 57th Street. When they opened the new famous store was on the downtown side. You know what I mean? Yeah. You know what I mean? You remember? You remember that? You remember New York? You know what I mean? I wasn't there. No, but I mean, but I've been in New York. You were in New York. The original famous store was on the uptown side. Yeah, I know what you mean. And Wayne got the job in the old famous store, you see. But it didn't last. It lasted about two weeks and he folded up. I don't know.
Do you remember any of the tunes that you recorded with Wayne?

I'll tell you a truth. It's a shame. Downstream is the only one I remember. And when other sides came out about the same time, we made six sides. I believe. Three records, I guess it was six sides. Yeah. Yeah. But Downstream is the only one I can recall.
Do you remember any numbers like Annie Laurie? Did you make that or not? Maybe. Did that come out about the same time?

How about the same time? That's why I'm checking. It probably was then. I just can't remember. Do you remember Loch Lomond? Yeah, Loch Lomond. That's what they did that. Yeah, that's it. Yeah, Loch Lomond. And Laurie, then Laurie, then we made that brush. Yeah. And what's some of the others? I can't remember.
Well, they made Where's the Waiter? Yeah, yeah, yeah.
Is that the one Where's the Waiter with the water for Madonna and all that stuff? Yeah, yeah, yeah. Now I remember. It comes back.

And my Nara Ucha take a steamboat? Do you remember that? Maybe that one. Maybe that one. And the Land of the Yamo Yamo? I don't remember about that one. They're real funny. You know, they're all Wingy's job. You know how Wingy was. Yeah, yeah, yeah. That's what I mean.
But that's what the Loch Lomond though, I remember doing that, I think. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. That's the one that...
You can't buy those records anymore? Yeah, I got something along by my house, I think. Yeah? I think, I believe. I think, yeah. Well, who was in Wingy's band?
